description: This file contains unit tests for the USBDevice component, including tests for device connection events, device list retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and device information retrieval. It uses Google Test framework and mocks various USB and system interactions to verify the behavior of the USBDevice implementation.

classes.name: USBDeviceTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing USBDevice functionalities, including device connection events, device list retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and device info retrieval. It sets up mocks for USB interactions and system calls.

methods.name: Mock_SetDeviceDesc
methods.description: Mocks the device descriptor information for a specific bus number and device address, including setting device class, subclass, and creating mock vendor/model files.

methods.name: Mock_SetSerialNumberInUSBDevicePath
methods.description: Creates mock serial number files for USB devices and device paths to simulate system files.
